_notes: Generated from a read-only walk of the new app shell on dev (web-pet #1569 'PET Tiger Cloud new experience', 2026-11-05).
sidebar: the top-level links and the hub page each opens. screens: every screen reachable from a hub card, keyed by its route; 'card' is the card's full text (title + description).

LeftNavigationPage.openViaMenu resolves a screen route here: sidebar link -> hub card with that href -> screen. A route in noMenuEntry is opened by address with a deep-link annotation; any other absent route falls back to the old group walk.

noMenuEntry./input/crew-piece-out: no Input hub card (product gap since 2026-10-16; the new shell did not add one)
noMenuEntry./reports/scripts: the Reports hub is a report catalogue since web-pet #1569 (2026-11-05); Report Scripts is a category there, the screen itself has no card
noMenuEntry./reports/input/job-card: the Reports hub runs reports directly since web-pet #1569 (2026-11-05); the Job Card Report Selection screen has no card
noMenuEntry./reports/input/time-in: the Reports hub runs reports directly since web-pet #1569 (2026-11-05); the Time In Report Selection route answers Page not found
